resources.string: Keep on for Bluetooth speakers, headphones and earbuds. Off may skip Dolby and other phone effects. On can add a little audio delay.
A little more delay can prevent stutters and pauses.
Phone effects uses Android’s normal sound path for supported Dolby and equalisers. Enable the effects in your phone settings. This can add audio delay.
Buffering controls how long Sukut waits before playing cleaned sound. Lowest starts sooner. Balanced helps keep sound steady. Maximum waits longer to prevent pauses. The music filter stays the same.
